messages:
Tara (Design): Proposal: a tiny "preview strip" above the heatmap showing p95 band + tiny throughput ticks. Primary actions: jump-to-range and pin. Quick feedback?
Omar (Frontend): Good for quick scans. Concern: too many interactive targets in 320px width. Recommend hidden overflow menu for extra actions.
Lee (Product): Ops use-case: instant jump to suspect window. Keep the chevron visible and tappable; hide less-used actions in menu.
Rin (A11y): Accessibility: no hover-only reveals. Make chevron focusable, add aria-label='Jump to time range', announce summary on focus.
Tara (Design): Agree. Also thinking colorblind palette + icon supplement for severity.
Omar (Frontend): Implementation: canvas for visuals + positioned buttons for hit areas. Will prototype with offscreen text summary for screen readers.
infra-bot: Infra: interval-agg service will provide 60s buckets; sampling default on ranges >1h. Endpoint: /v1/intervals?res=60s
Lee (Product): Copy: replace 'Anomaly' with 'Spike' and include severity label (info/warn/critical).
Rin (A11y): Tooltip timing: 250ms for keyboard discovery. Provide keyboard shortcut hint in tooltip.
Tara (Design): Action items: Omar to prototype, Rin to draft a11y spec, Lee to update PRD. I'll add Figma variants for compact vs full. Thanks!
